bill.title: A Resolution directing the Joint State Government Commission to conduct a study on the feasibility, community impact and process for converting immigrant detention centers operating in this Commonwealth into community-centered projects, with fair, transparent and rigorous local stakeholder participation as a condition for eligibility for State transition grant funds.

posted_text:
👮 Immigration
PA HR 673 — Pennsylvania Wants to Rethink Immigration Detention

This bill directs Pennsylvania to study how to transform immigration detention centers into community-focused projects, addressing concerns about deaths in detention and negative impacts on local communities. ...
